# AIARE - American Institute for Avalanche Research and Education

> > AIARE provides gold-standard avalanche education, safety courses, and instructor certification for backcountry recreationalists and outdoor professionals.

The American Institute for Avalanche Research and Education (AIARE) is the leading organization for avalanche safety training in North America. AIARE offers a comprehensive recreational curriculum covering avalanche awareness, backcountry travel techniques, and snow science, while also certifying instructors through rigorous training programs. The organization partners with avalanche centers like CAIC and NWAC to deliver courses across regions including Colorado and the Pacific Northwest.

## Key Topics

- AIARE (American Institute for Avalanche Research and Education)
- Avalanche education and safety courses
- Backcountry safety and travel
- Instructor Training Course (ITC)
- AIARE Recreational Curriculum
- Snow science and avalanche awareness
- Instructor certification and professional training
- Colorado Avalanche Information Center (CAIC)
- Northwest Avalanche Center (NWAC)
- Avalanche Aware program
- Course applications and teaching certification
- Outdoor instruction and training
- Free online avalanche programs
